layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Focus on organic asymmetry and breathing room.

hero_background.description: Abstract shapes with warm lighting and reflections, used for hero section background or image generation empty states.

feature_lens.description: Minimalist pottery vases, use as a placeholder for Google Lens / photo search feature demonstration.

deep_research.description: Artisanal pottery on wooden shelf, used as visual metaphor for deep research and organized memory.

texture_overlay.description: Dynamic abstract digital art with earthy shades, useful for pricing cards background or premium pro plan highlighting.

nature_minimal.description: Expansive sand dunes with tiny figures, used as an atmospheric background for the sign-up page or empty chat state.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) and change background color. Use smooth transitions (duration-300).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in content with a slight upward translation.
motion_and_interactions.chat_animations: New messages should slide up and fade in.
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: Focus states must be highly visible. e.g. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#B25638] focus:ring-offset-2

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a SaaS layout with authentication (Google Sign-In), marketing landing page, pricing page, and the core dashboard (Ankit GPT 2.0).
Implement navigation linking to the key features: Chat, Image Gen, Deep Research, Lens, Settings.
Use Shadcn components for forms, dropdowns, and dialogs, but style them WITHOUT standard 'tech' borders. Use the defined warm muted colors and rounded-2xl border-radii.
For the main chat interface, ensure it looks clean and conversational with 'chat_bubble' styles from components config. Add a prominent microphone icon button for the Voice Search mode.
In the Chat interface, provide an attachment/camera button for 'Photo search mode' (Google Lens style).
Implement 'Deep Research' as a toggle or separate tab in the chat that adds a more focused, document-heavy layout view.
In the Pricing/Plans section, show three tiers: Free, Go (₹200/month), Pro (₹400/month). Highlight the Pro plan using the `texture_overlay` image as a subtle background or border highlight.
Ensure all buttons, interactive elements, and forms have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='chat-submit-button'`, `data-testid='google-signin-button'`).
Avoid using teal, purple, or pure black. Stick strictly to the warm earthy color palette (#FDFBF7, #1A1D1A, #B25638, etc.).
Do not use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans. Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Manrope for body text.
Add tailwind configuration to match the colors and typography accurately in the global css or tailwind.config.js.
Implement responsive design starting mobile-first. Make sure the chat interface works smoothly on mobile screens with bottom-anchored inputs.
